decision: Implement classifier as research-only pure function first; do not widen Production API before prospective data exists.

readerAudit.existingResearchInternalReader: readResearchSnapshots already reads snapshot updated_at and snapshot_json from first-primary D1
readerAudit.existingResearchDashboardApi: does not expose raw snapshot rows/timestamps
readerAudit.conclusion: Storage and internal reader are sufficient in principle, but no external read-only audit can currently pair both timestamps without widening an API. Defer surface expansion until prospective selected rows exist.
